```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(htmltools)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)


knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$style(HTML("
    .leaflet-container {
      background: #ffffff !important;
    }
  "))
)


```


```{r data prep, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

# read and prep shape
shp <- st_read("inputs/sections.shp") |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  arrange(MAP_UNIT_N) |>
  filter(!grepl("water", MAP_UNIT_N, ignore.case = TRUE))

# list report files once
report_files <- list.files(
  "reports",
  pattern = "\\.html$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

# build reports lookup table
reports <- tibble(
  MAP_UNIT_N = report_files |>
    tools::file_path_sans_ext() |>
    (\(x) gsub("_", " ", x))() |>
    trimws(),
  path = file.path("reports", report_files)
)

# join reports onto spatial object
shp <- shp |>
  left_join(reports, by = "MAP_UNIT_N")



```



Column {data-width=900}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

<font size="6"> Region 9 National Forests </font>

```{r clickable map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.height="700px"}

epsg5070 <- leafletCRS(
  crsClass = "L.Proj.CRS",
  code = "EPSG:5070",
  proj4def = "+proj=laea +lat_0=45 +lon_0=-100 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +a=6370997 +b=6370997 +units=m +no_defs",
  resolutions = 2 ^ (16:7)
)

plot_eco_sections <- function() {
  leaflet(
    shp,
    options = leafletOptions(crs = epsg5070),
    width = "100%",
    height = "100%"
  ) |>
    addPolygons(
      color = "#404241",
      weight = 1,
      smoothFactor = 0.5,
      opacity = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.1,
      fillColor = "#0b631a",
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        color = "white",
        weight = 3,
        bringToFront = TRUE
      ),
      popup = ifelse(
        is.na(shp$path),
        paste0("<b>", shp$MAP_UNIT_N, "</b><br>no report available yet"),
        paste0("<b>", shp$MAP_UNIT_N, "</b><br>", shp$path, "open report</a>")
      )
    ) |>
    
    htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;

      setTimeout(function() {
        map.setView([1000000, 0], 2, {animate: false});
      }, 0);
    }
")
  
}

plot_eco_sections()

```
